name: Brendon Barendse
testimony: Our job is R&D. Building great products for large-scale national projects. Marketing was never going to get our attention, but we still need a sales pipeline to show for it. Creative Seat lets us build that pipeline in the background while we stay heads-down on the product. We don’t manage a creative process, we just get the leads.

name: Ryan Le Roux
subscript: Founder and CEO, Leva Foundation / Tangible
testimony: We operate across 32 countries, which means every campaign has to speak to a different audience without starting from scratch each time. Creative Seat is the only way we’ve found to do that at scale: consistent brand, content that actually lands locally, without us needing a production team in every country we work in.
